This template is to be used to denote the first time an article's subject is identified under a specific name or identity.

==Usage==
Add this template next to a source in which the article subject is first identified under the provided name.
<code><nowiki>{{1stID|name|simult}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para||name}} - The name under which the subject is first identified in the source.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para||simult}} - Any source that simultaneously first identifies the subject under the same name as another source. Used by itself as {{Para|simult}}.

==Example(s)==
===Standard===
<code><nowiki>{{1stID|Hypori campaign}}</nowiki></code>

{{1stID|Hypori campaign}}

===Using {{Para||simult}}===
<code><nowiki>{{1stID|navigation buoy|''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]''}}</nowiki></code>

{{1stID|navigation buoy|''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]''}}
